answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 36605 Country: India Title: If I sell a product in which we adulterate some other thing but we tell the customer about it Question: If I sell a product in which we adulterate some other thing but we tell the customer about it for example we mix the sugar syrup in honey but we had explained about it is this transaction is halal for me. Answer ID: 36605 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 289/289/M=1433) The said business is lawful provided the customers are informed of it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
